integrity: The optimum-set and exchange claims are supported by self-contained exhaustive finite enumeration of all 8- and 9-sets, an independent hitting-constraint test, and explicit incidence isomorphism checks. The code is a complete finite proof at the stated order, not a statistical experiment.
scientific_limitations: Finite exact theorem for the point-line incidence graph of AG(2,3), not an infinite-family conclusion.
Closed-neighborhood identification and single-vertex exchange on optimum codes only.
The minimum cardinality nine follows from a known general degree bound, not asserted as original.
No independent audit has been performed; unindexed equivalent prior work remains possible.
title: Optimal identifying codes of the ternary affine-plane incidence graph form four Pappus components and an incidence cone
